trigger: A governed model has no executable implementation.
detection: Registry check at startup before any fitting.
p5_behavior: ABORT before any work. Never substitute a different model.
recorded_fields: series_id, model_name, metric, error_type, error_message, timestamp, batch_id, origin_date
notes: P5A verified all 15 resolve, so this should not trigger.

trigger: A model raises during fit or predict.
detection: try/except around each (series, model, origin) unit.
p5_behavior: Record the failure, continue with other units. Do NOT write a NaN prediction row.
recorded_fields: series_id, model_name, metric, error_type, error_message, timestamp, batch_id, origin_date
notes: No silent NaN. A missing row must be visible in the failure ledger, not disguised.

trigger: Fewer than 65 training rows at an origin.
detection: Pre-flight from the window contract, then re-checked at runtime.
p5_behavior: Skip that origin, record it. If a series has zero valid origins, abort the series and record it.
recorded_fields: series_id, model_name, metric, error_type, error_message, timestamp, batch_id, origin_date
notes: P5A measured 0 of 90 series with zero valid origins, so this is not expected.

trigger: An import fails (sklearn, statsmodels, lightgbm, xgboost).
recorded_fields: series_id, model_name, metric, error_type, error_message, timestamp, batch_id, origin_date
notes: P5A confirmed the pilot module imports cleanly.

p5_behavior: Finish the current batch, checkpoint, stop cleanly. Partial output stays in work/.
recorded_fields: series_id, model_name, metric, error_type, error_message, timestamp, batch_id, origin_date
notes: Partial results must never be promoted to processed/.

detection: np.isfinite check on every prediction vector.
p5_behavior: Reject the unit and record it as a failure. Never write the row.
recorded_fields: series_id, model_name, metric, error_type, error_message, timestamp, batch_id, origin_date
notes: The HDD reference already enforces this.

trigger: prediction_date != target_date, or actual_value does not match actuals_normalized.
detection: Post-batch assertion joining predictions back to actuals_normalized on (series_id, target_date).
p5_behavior: ABORT the batch. This is a correctness failure, not a tolerable one.
recorded_fields: series_id, model_name, metric, error_type, error_message, timestamp, batch_id, origin_date
notes: THE MOST IMPORTANT CHECK. A silent one-day offset would make every accuracy number wrong while looking plausible.

trigger: A checkpoint lacks a contract column or has a wrong dtype.
detection: Schema assertion before each checkpoint write.
recorded_fields: series_id, model_name, metric, error_type, error_message, timestamp, batch_id, origin_date
